overview.value: After the tragic death of his daughter, Suga, the leader of a notorious motorcycle club, struggles to keep his family and club together. With rival gangs and a ruthless prosecutor hot on his heels, Suga's world collapses when his own brotherhood betrays him. Now he faces an impossible choice: reclaim his power or protect his grieving family.

Suga has been put in 'bad standing' by his own club and goes in search of new allies to recover the lost drugs. Lynn tries to repair the failed case against Suga, while she and her niece are haunted by a past in which Suga plays a key role. Marcel will have to prove where his loyalties lie: will he choose the club, or will he protect his family?

Candy desperately searches for the missing Melissa, while Suga continues his hunt for the missing drugs. As they come together to find their daughter, they discover shocking secrets that completely turn their family ties and the dynamics within the club upside down. Meanwhile, Lynn's addiction poses a great danger not only to herself, but also to her young niece Zoë.

Suga has little time to save his daughter Melissa, but at the same time sees an opportunity to take revenge on Spike. Spike reveals his secret collaboration with an unexpected ally and carries out his own plan. As tensions rise, Candy takes matters into her own hands and forces Suga and Spike into an ultimate confrontation, where the truth finally comes to light.

Suga embarks on a risky mission to rescue Melissa, but first he must win back his old club and face his old enemy. Lynn's problems pile up as her secret collaboration threatens to be exposed, prompting her to make a pact with Suga to protect their families. Ultimately, all secrets and loyalties are put to the test in a deadly confrontation.
